request: Rebuild Mia to approved v22 art in face/body, hair, garments, accessories order; inspect every stage in multiple views and scales.
method_revision: User-requested side-review correction: preserve expression-ready anime topology; co-design geometry, owned eye/brow/lash parts, textures, toon/normal shading and morphs. Procedural skull experiments remain rejected evidence.
reference_authority: asset/mia/references/mia-clean-master-v22.png and mia-canonical-source-v22.png; expressions for face identity
coordinate_convention: Front is -Y. Anatomical left braid, anatomical right slate pants panel. Pose differences from pocketed art must be stated.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Licensed editable anime facial base with eyelid/mouth expression structure, intact face/body volume, owned eye/brow/lash components, Mia facial proportions and supported bust-waist-hip silhouette; no v45 geometry reuse.
acceptance_criteria.user_visible_outcome: Face and body remain volumetric and coherent from front, side, back and three-quarter closeups.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Separate structure QA (clay/wire/face orientation/volume/intersections/actual blink and mouth deformation) and art QA (real eye/liner/skin textures and toon/normal setup against reference); 12 yaw x 3 elevation x 3 scales, closeup and perspective supplement. Source hash preservation. Separate parts do not require forced skin welding.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Source rights/provenance, preserved original facial topology and morphs, anatomy checkpoint, structure/art audits, blink/mouth proof and SHA-bound stage review

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Separate owned scalp/hair with irregular bangs, full rear waves, half-up knot and one anatomical-left braid.
acceptance_criteria.user_visible_outcome: Hair has coherent thickness and silhouette during rotation without removing face surfaces or duplicating braid.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Hair isolation and complete 216-view saved/clay audit; scalp/face clearance and reference comparison.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Hair checkpoint blend, audit report, owner inventory, SHA-bound stage review

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Separate crop tee, inner band, oversized cardigan, patch cargo pants, socks and sneakers with actual thickness and no visible rest-pose body clipping.
acceptance_criteria.user_visible_outcome: Floating crop hem, low cardigan rear hem, loose sleeves, right-leg slate panel and footwear match the art from all sides.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Garment isolation, complete 216-view saved/clay audit, exposed-skin/hem coverage review. Complete anatomy original preserved.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Garment checkpoint blend, coverage report, audit, SHA-bound stage review

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Single crossbody strap, rear bag, cyan/brass pin, chain and tags with clear Bag/Hardware ownership and physical detail layers.
acceptance_criteria.user_visible_outcome: Strap follows torso, bag sits behind hip, flap/window/cards/clasp have real depth and no duplicate assemblies appear in three-quarter views.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Accessory isolation, complete 216-view saved/clay audit, ownership/clearance/reference review.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Final modeling blend, inventory, audit, SHA-bound stage review

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Review and repair each stage before dependent modeling proceeds; require both structure and art QA. Preserve checkpoints and failed procedural experiments, distinguish geometry from normal/material causes, and report artistic gaps honestly.
acceptance_criteria.user_visible_outcome: Actual stage evidence and identified limitations remain available; image counts never imply likeness acceptance.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Sequential stage reviews tied to exact source hashes plus fresh independent acceptance audit.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Stage review records, final independent audit; FAIL/UNVERIFIED cannot be called complete

later_work: Rigging, facial expressions, pose collision/correctives and event animation follow modeling acceptance; this contract covers static modeling.
